notable_absence.finding: Passive mode's introduction is dated explicitly ('in Couchbase Server 5.5 and beyond'), but Active and Off modes carry no version at all - Off is described only as 'the behavior of Couchbase Server pre-5.5', which dates a BEHAVIOR, not the mode's own introduction as a selectable option, and Active mode's introduction is never dated on this page at all. Also absent: the round brief's assumption that compression restrictions might interact with bucket type is close to vacuous here, since 'can be applied only to Couchbase and Ephemeral buckets' names the only two bucket types this batch's pages recognize at all (see buckets.json's Memcached-bucket-absence finding) - the restriction reads as leftover phrasing from an era when a third bucket type existed, not as an active constraint today.

cross_component_finding: This page names 'cbbackup' and 'cbrestore' as the tools that request compressed items in the backup stream - different names from the already-promoted tool:cbbackupmgr ('the command-line backup and restore utility'). cbbackupmgr is documented elsewhere as the current backup CLI; cbbackup/cbrestore read like legacy/superseded tool names, but no page in either extraction states that relationship explicitly, so tool:cbbackup and tool:cbrestore are minted separately here rather than merged into or marked as superseded-by tool:cbbackupmgr. Flagged for reconciliation/SME review rather than resolved, per this round's explicit instruction not to invent a superseding relationship without a page stating it.
